task: patient-level binary Murmur Present (1) vs Absent (0); Unknown excluded
group: canonical subject_id = connected components of Additional ID links
segmentation: dataset .tsv (expert-assisted) => ORACLE-segmentation-assisted; min 40 systolic cols, 40 diastolic cols, 10 S1 cols per recording
aggregation: patient vector = [median, max] over recordings of each recording feature (NaN-aware)

feature_sets.B0: conventional acoustic: 13 MFCC means + centroid + bandwidth + rolloff + ZCR + RMS-envelope CV (18)
feature_sets.B1: Vimalajeewa et al. 2025 features, authors' own MATLAB values re-aligned to recordings (10 -> 8 used as in their demo)

primary: sensitivity at train-derived threshold for specificity>=0.80
metrics.thresholds: chosen ONLY on inner grouped OOF predictions of the training part: (a) specificity>=0.80, (b) max weighted accuracy

uncertainty: subject-level bootstrap (2000 resamples of canonical subjects) on repeat-averaged patient scores; paired differences on identical patients

hypotheses.H1_leakage: B1 + paper SVM (RBF, C=100, gamma=0.1, class weight 1:4): recording-level metrics under random 80/20 recording split exceed those under subject-grouped CV
hypotheses.H2_wavelet_vs_fourier: A_wpd(db4) AUROC > A_stft AUROC (and W_wpd > W_stft)

success_rule: a contrast is SUPPORTED if RF delta-AUROC >= 0.03, subject-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0, and the delta is positive in >= 18/25 outer folds; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED (reported as is)
forbidden: no test-fold use for feature selection, wavelet/depth choice, thresholds, hyperparameters, or choosing which result to report
